_about: Waivers are COMMITTED ON PURPOSE. A hidden waiver is a disabled rule.
_rules: rid        - a rule id from src/jumpper/hardening.py (--list-rules to see them)
pathGlob   - scope. '*' and '**' are REFUSED; a global waiver disables the rule
reason     - why this is acceptable right now. A ticket reference is expected
approvedBy - a named human, not 'agent' and not 'auto'
expiresAt  - unix seconds. MANDATORY. A waiver with no expiry is refused
_note: Every active waiver is printed in every gate run, valid or not, so nothing is silently suppressed.
